components.label: Compose environment, localization, routes and app shell
responsibilities: Select the development or remote provider graph and build the localized routed app.

requires.rationale: Construct route screens and feature state, and provide the app shell’s localization, theme and scroll behavior.
Select the local and remote repositories and service implementations for each environment.
Construct booking operations for the app provider graph.

components.label: presentation
responsibilities: Own screen state, rendering and user interaction.

requires.rationale: Use travel values and booking operations in routed presentation features.
View models consume the sample’s repository ports, which are declared with the data adapters.
Use the shared asynchronous command and result contracts.

requires.component: Compose environment, localization, routes and app shell
requires.rationale: Presentation screens use the app route definitions for navigation.

components.label: domain
responsibilities: Own travel data types and booking operations.

requires.rationale: Use repository ports to resolve destinations and activities and persist completed bookings.
Booking sharing uses the sample’s shared date formatter.
Booking operations return the shared Result type.

components.label: data
responsibilities: Own repository contracts, persistence, local data and API adapters.

requires.rationale: Exchange typed domain values through the repository and service adapters.

requires.component: Compose environment, localization, routes and app shell
requires.rationale: Local data loading reads the app-owned bundled asset paths.
Repository and service contracts use the shared Result type.

components.label: utilities
responsibilities: Own generic async commands, result values and image error support.

rules.rationale: Dependencies outside the declared component boundaries are not part of the Target.
